title: The component normalization square for completed Koszul tensor augmentation
statement: Let T be a scheme, A a commutative ring, d an adic coefficient datum, r a natural number, a : Fin r -> A, n a natural number, P an arbitrary unbounded cochain complex of completed coefficient module sheaves, U the cochain tensor unit, K the recorded completed exterior Koszul complex at n and Q the recorded finite quotient module at n [def-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction-models]. Let b : Tot(P tensor K) -> (P tensor Q) and bU : Tot(U tensor K) -> (U tensor Q), where the targets are the actual termwise ordinary tensors of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-koszul-tensor-quotient-augmentation]. Assume the unit normalization equations for b and bU, and that b is zero on every total summand (p,q) with q nonzero. Let j be the inverse of the single-degree-zero total tensor comparison at U, followed by the left unitor U tensor Q[0] -> Q[0]. Then (P tensor bU) followed by (P tensor j) and the single-degree-zero total tensor comparison at P equals (P tensor lambda_K) followed by b. This is one equality of maps of complexes at a fixed n; neither naturality of b,bU, strict tower compatibility, cones, K-flatness nor derived limits are assumed or concluded.

source.place: Tag 099M, proof of lemma-naive-completion, finite tensor of the Koszul augmentation; sites-cohomology.tex, Definition 06YN (total tensor). Agent expansion of the normalization calculation in steps 1 and 2 of lem-weil-pbc-completed-koszul-tensor-cone-comparison.

proof.text: Write c = lambda_K inverse, then bU, then j. Exterior degree zero is the rank-one coefficient module. The constant unit and its scalar extension identify the recorded degree-zero Koszul unit u with an invertible unit-module map. The unit normalization of bU, the degree-zero component of the single-tensor comparison and naturality of the module unitors imply u followed by c^0 equals the prescribed quotient unit. In nonzero degrees c^q is zero since its target Q[0]^q is zero.

Compare b with total tensor P tensor c followed by the single-degree-zero comparison. Detect their components by the total tensor summand injections. For q nonzero the two composites vanish by the hypothesis on b and the zero target component of c. For q=0 precompose the summand with P^p tensor u, which is invertible. The unit equation of b and the formula for c^0 give the same map P^p -> P^p tensor Q. Naturality of the module right unitor gives equality after that precomposition, and cancellation gives equality on the summand.

Use joint detection to conclude the equality of maps of complexes. Precompose with tensor of lambda_K and cancel its inverse to obtain precisely the displayed square. These computations are valid for unbounded P and degenerate rings, ideals and ranks; there are no infinite products or boundedness arguments.

lean.statement:
theorem completedKoszulTensorAugmentationComponent
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ)
    (b : completedAdicKoszulTensor T d r a P n ⟶
      (((completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).asFunctor.obj
        (op n))
    (bU : completedAdicKoszulTensor T d r a (𝟙_ _) n ⟶
      (((completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (𝟙_ _)).asFunctor.obj (op n))
    (hu : completedAdicKoszulTensorUnit T d r a P n ≫ b =
      completedQuotientTensorUnit T d P n)
    (hz : ∀ (p q : ℤ), q ≠ 0 →
      completedKoszulTensorSummand T d r a P n p q ≫ b.f (p + q) = 0)
    (huU : completedAdicKoszulTensorUnit T d r a (𝟙_ _) n ≫ bU =
      completedQuotientTensorUnit T d (𝟙_ _) n) :
    P ◁ bU ≫ (tensorLeft P).map
        ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso (curriedTensor _)
          (completedAdicFiniteModule T d n) (𝟙_ _)).inv ≫
            (λ_ ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (completedAdicFiniteModule T d n))).hom) ≫
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso (curriedTensor _)
          (completedAdicFiniteModule T d n) P).hom =
      P ◁ (λ_ (completedAdicKoszul T d r a n)).hom ≫ b
